v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Proprio de Tempore

text.la: Dómine, * lábia mea apéries, et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.
text.en: O Lord, open Thou my lips, * and my mouth shall show forth thy praise.

text.la: Déxtera Dómini * fecit virtútem: déxtera Dómini exaltávit me.
text.en: The right hand of the Lord * hath done valiantly, the right hand of the Lord hath exalted me.

text.la: Factus est * adiútor meus, Deus meus.
text.en: My God * hath been my help.

text.la: Trium puerórum * cantémus hymnum, quem cantábant in camíno ignis, benedicéntes Dóminum.
text.en: Let us sing the Song of the Three Children, * even the Song that they sang when they blessed the Lord in the burning fiery furnace.

text.la: Státuit ea * in ætérnum, et in sǽculum sǽculi: præcéptum pósuit, et non præteríbit.
text.en: He hath established them * for ever and ever: He hath made a decree which shall not pass.

text.la: Fratres: Rogámus vos, et obsecrámus in Dómino Iesu: ut, quemádmodum accepístis a nobis, quómodo vos opórteat ambuláre, et placére Deo, sic et ambulétis, ut abundétis magis.
text.en: For the rest therefore, brethren, we pray and beseech you in the Lord Jesus, that as you have received from us, how you ought to walk, and to please God, so also you would walk, that you may abound the more.

v.la: Ángelis suis Deus mandávit de te.
v.en: God hath given His Angels charge over thee.

r.la: Ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.
r.en: To keep thee in all thy ways.

text.la: Assúmpsit Iesus * discípulos suos, et ascéndit in montem, et transfigurátus est ante eos.
text.en: Jesus took His disciples, * and went up into a mountain, and was transfigured before them.

text.la: Deus, qui cónspicis omni nos virtúte destítui: intérius exteriúsque custódi; ut ab ómnibus adversitátibus muniámur in córpore, et a pravis cogitatiónibus mundémur in mente.
text.en: O God, Who seest that we have no power of ourselves to help ourselves, keep us both outwardly in our bodies, and inwardly in our souls, that we may be defended from all adversities which may happen to the body, and from all evil thoughts which may assault and hurt the soul.
